title: Four-panel data figure

intent.message: Four complementary views present one dataset: spatial extent, a profile, a correlation, and a time series.

claims.statement: Panels a to d present complementary views of the same study area and dataset.

expected_design_characteristics: An aligned 2x2 grid with equal gutters and matched panel edges
One font ramp and axis style shared by all four panels
Panel labels a to d in a consistent corner position
The shared legend rendered once, outside the panel content
known_failure_modes: Unequal gutters or misaligned panel edges
Inconsistent font sizes or axis treatments across panels
The same legend duplicated in several panels
